environment_note: .env is not loaded automatically; export variables in the local environment.

task_map.intent: Check the Robinhood testnet network, latest block and address balance without signing in.
effects: Read-only HTTP requests; no account, key or transaction is created.
task_map.success: Live catalog chain_id matches eth_chainId before block/balance reads; exit 0.

task_map.intent: Read the testnet, obtain or reuse a key, establish filtered logs, then read mainnet using the same key.
effects: An existing BLOCKVECTRA_API_KEY skips wallet login and key creation.
Without an existing API key, signs a SIWE login message and creates one API key; the first sign-in for that wallet creates an account.
Without WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, a fresh throwaway wallet is generated in memory; repeated runs create new accounts.
Generated wallet/key secrets are discarded from memory at process exit; created server-side keys are not automatically revoked.
If supplying WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, use a dedicated throwaway wallet, never one holding funds or used elsewhere.
task_map.success: Step1 passes; logs subscription acknowledged, 30 seconds monitored, unsubscribe result=true; mainnet RPC and stocks reads succeed; exit 0.
task_map.failure: Non-zero exit; logs setup/listening/unsubscribe failure prevents the mainnet read.

stages.network_guard: Compares live catalog chain_id with eth_chainId before other reads.

task_map.intent: Read a mainnet block and indexed stock-token activity using an existing key.
effects: Read-only HTTP requests; no account, key or transaction is created.
task_map.data_note: On-chain stock-token activity, not stock-market quotes. The response may describe an earlier recorded day; inspect its day and metadata before treating it as current.

task_map.intent: Find supported testnet faucet requirements and error handling before requesting test ETH.
effects: This repository has no faucet claim command; opening the guide does not request funds.

attribution_note: ref is an optional source label, not authenticated identity or proof of referral.

field_notes.existing_api_key_required: Whether an API key must already exist before running the command; null means not applicable for a guide-only entry.
